title: Climate zones 4 to 6: at least 70% of dwellings get 2 hours of sun to living rooms and private open space, and at most 15% in a building get none
text: In climate zones 4, 5 and 6 only: (a) Dwellings with a northern aspect are maximised, with a minimum of 70 per cent of dwellings having living rooms and private open space that obtain at least 2 hours direct sunlight between 9am and 3pm on 21 June AND (b) A maximum of 15 per cent of dwellings in a building receiving no direct sunlight between 9am and 3pm on 21 June.

replaces.note: register C4P2-110 change_type 'new' refers to DG 4.1.4 only; A4.1.1 to A4.1.4 unchanged

notes: from: ch4p1 C2.2.2 (same 70% / 15% test). diverges: the 2 hours must reach both the living rooms and the private open space (ch4p1: primary living space only); supply dwellings.with_2h_sun_pct counting only dwellings where both do. (b) is per building: supply the worst building. 'Dwellings with a northern aspect are maximised' is qualitative and left to O4.1.1.
